newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Micron higher after news.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Micron higher after news.

text.p: Micron Technology Inc shares rose 2/8 to 33-1/8 in after-hours trading on Thursday after a late-afternoon forecast by the company that it would record a second-quarter gain as a result of a recent deal.

Otherwise, after-hour trading was light, despite a record-setting regular session in which the Dow Jones index closed above 7,000 for the first time. "I haven't really seen all that much so far," one after-hours trader said.
Micron Technology opened on the New York Stock Exchange at 33-1/4, then fell to 32-7/8 by the end of regular hours.
